set.body: Introduce the typed method/result layer for paired latent analyses. Acceptance: PairedLatentMethod, CcaRegularization, RegressionDirection, RegressionRegularization, and PairedLatentFit are small immutable Scala 3 types; raw Double convenience inputs normalize immediately into linalg Ridge-backed values.
set.title: Multivar: add paired latent method and fit ADTs
